single.title: A bedroom filled with details
prompts: Give the folded blanket on the bed a fine herringbone weave. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged.
Add a narrow embroidered border to the towel hanging over the footboard. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged.
Place a small porcelain water pitcher on the bedside table, clear of the existing basins. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged.
Add a matching porcelain cup beside the pitcher. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged.
Set a small folded cloth beneath the pitcher and cup. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged.
Fit a small brass reading-light shade to the existing floor lamp, retaining its stand. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged.
Aim the lamp head slightly downward toward the pillow. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged.
Switch on the lamp with a gentle pool of light on the bed. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged.
Add a shallow shelf above the white cabinet, clear of the wall plaque. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged.
Place two small amber apothecary bottles on the shelf. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged.
Give each bottle a cream label with a simple botanical drawing and no text. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged.
Add a neatly rolled bandage on the shelf beside the bottles. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged.
Fit a slim metal label holder to the bed's footboard. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged.
Insert a cream card reading 'Bed 1' into the holder. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged.
Slightly extend the canvas downward with matching floor and furniture legs. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged.
Place a small braided oval rug on the floor beside the bed. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged.
Add two neatly aligned slippers at the rug's far end. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged.
Add a small lace edge to the pillowcase, without changing the pillow's size. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged.
Place a closed clothbound book near the folded blanket, clear of the pillow. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged.
Add a slim ribbon bookmark protruding from the clothbound book. Retain the herringbone blanket, embroidered towel, reading lamp, and apothecary jars. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged.
